entries.2b4e5796918f0a7d: DISCO CORPORATION has only 1 reportable segment, the Precision Processing Systems Business, and the sales of ¥436,889 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 are all from this business. The company has set "Advanced Kiru, Kezuru and Migaku technologies" as its business theme, and without departing from the 3 technology areas of "cutting," "grinding" and "polishing," it makes and sells precision processing equipment, which is [[term:semiconductor-manufacturing-equipment|semiconductor manufacturing equipment]], and precision processing tools, which are consumables attached to and used with that equipment, and also provides maintenance and services.

entries.6f3a9518dee1dc74: In the technology fields of "cutting," "grinding" and "polishing," the company manufactures and sells precision processing equipment (equipment) and precision processing tools (consumables), and also provides maintenance and services. The company states that the business is characterized by providing comprehensive solutions to customers' processing challenges, not simply selling products, through four elements: equipment, consumables, application technology that combines the two to derive optimal processing conditions, and after-sales service that supports stable operation after installation. It positions "test cutting," in which it receives workpieces from customers and conducts processing verification free of charge, as the entry point of its business model.
entries.8221f15b7b82d118: Equipment for processing [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]] and other items.
entries.a9f27235a7132037: In addition to precision processing equipment and precision processing tools, it provides application technology that combines equipment and consumables to derive optimal processing conditions, and after-sales service following installation. The company explains that setting these processing conditions is difficult without engineers well versed in the technology, and that it is not easy for customers to do this themselves.

entries.b727740eb05c5cd4: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥184,989 million (operating margin 42.3%), ordinary profit was ¥184,936 million, and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥135,521 million. The company explains that although profit margins declined due to changes in the mix of products and applications and personnel and R&D costs increased, revenue and profit both rose owing to higher sales and contributions from high value-added products.
entries.b958f4e04bafd0f8: These are consumables used by attaching them to equipment. The company explains that slight differences in processing conditions, such as the rotation speed and feed rate of precision processing tools, can greatly change processing results. Because they are consumables, shipments in the fiscal year ended March 2026 remained at high levels, moving in line with customers' equipment utilization rates and other factors.
entries.bec7daa241ecda24: Equipment for processing [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]] and other items. Dicing saws and laser saws were developed as equipment for cutting, and grinders and polishers as equipment for grinding and polishing. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, shipments were strong, centered on high-value-added products for high-performance semiconductors, against a backdrop of data center investment for generative AI.

entries.d5c522811027dbfa: Customers are involved in the design and manufacture of semiconductors and electronic components, and mainly belong to the high-tech industry. The customer that accounted for 10% or more of revenue in the same year was Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd. (¥48,240 million, 11.0%).
